people.imagined: Noon on the founder's tower, the sea glittering below. He stands with his back to the stone and his face to the water, never the other way. In his hand the old bronze storm lamp burns a pale flame in full sun. He has been up all night again.
people.subject: The moment: at noon on a stone tower top he stands facing the sea with a lit bronze storm lamp held low at his side, its small flame plainly visible in full sunlight. Face: a tall man's long, grave face, salt-greyed, the skin weathered brown and fine-lined by wind; deep-set dark eyes with a faint red rim of sleeplessness, narrowed against the glare; a long straight nose; a thin mouth turned slightly down; a close grey-white beard along the jaw. Hair: grey as sea-foam, drawn up in a topknot and held by a gold hairpin shaped like a lamp-ray, a strip of dark blue pearl-diver's line wound through it. Body: tall, upright, lean, never turned from the water. Clothing: the head's richest robe, a knee-length coat of gold-threaded grey brocade woven with tides and lamp-rays, over two crossed collars of oiled grey silk and a long dark blue under-robe whose wide sleeves stream in the sea wind; brass toggles at the breast, a brass lamp-hook and a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: in the right hand a bronze storm lamp with horn panes and a ring handle; the left hand rests on the stone parapet. Power: a calm, deep-blue aura of water qi lies about him like a tide held back, with a few pale motes rising from the flame. Background: a blurred wide sea of pale grey-blue mist and a long coast, one gull. Light: soft white spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle rim glow, the lamp flame shining in front of it. Expression: unsleeping, weighed down, resolute and silent.

people.imagined: Afternoon on the palace jetty at Thạch Cơ. She stands square on the cracked stone, measuring the sea wall with her eyes as if with a rule, the black jetty shard hanging at her chest. She has been arguing for a century and tires of it, but not of the wall.
people.subject: The moment: standing square on a cracked stone jetty in the afternoon sea-haze, she measures the wall before her with narrowed eyes, one hand lifted with thumb and forefinger set a span apart. Face: a square, strong face, jaw heavy, skin weathered tan; level dark eyes with a sharp, measuring stare under heavy straight brows; a firm flat-bridged nose; lips closed in a stubborn line; two deep lines from nose to mouth. Hair: black with a few grey streaks, coiled at the nape and held by two black stone hairpins. Body: broad square shoulders, solid, planted. Clothing: an elder's gold-threaded grey brocade robe woven with tide-waves, its hem white with dried salt, worn over two crossed collars of oiled grey silk and a long pale grey under-robe with wide layered sleeves; brass toggles at the breast, a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: on a cord at her chest hangs a jagged palm-sized shard of pale stone, cracked and rough, faintly glowing; her right hand is raised in the measuring gesture; a slab of black stone lies behind her left hand on the parapet. Power: a steady earth-brown aura clings to her like a wall of dust, with slow yellow motes drifting from the shard. Background: blurred grey sea-wall stones, a crack in the stone, soft surf in mist. Light: cool silver sea-light from the upper left with a pale glowing rim. Expression: hard, patient, unconvinced.

people.imagined: Midnight at the seaward tower of a crumbling fort. He holds the lamp low and stares out at a dark sea where he has seen sails with no lamps. He has written, and nobody has answered. His eyes have gone pale from the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at midnight on the seaward tower of a ruined fort he stares into the black dark with a lit lamp held up beside his face, the flame lighting one half of it. Face: his eyes are a washed, milky pale grey, nearly white, wide open and fixed. A gaunt, hollowed, deeply weathered face, grey skin the colour of driftwood; cheekbones standing out; a long nose; a thin, cracked mouth slightly open; a scrubby grey beard. Hair: thin white-grey, hanging lank to the collar, wet with sea spray, held up by a single worn silver pin. Body: tall, bony, stooped at the shoulders. Clothing: the inner disciple's oiled grey silk robe, old and faded, with a collar embroidered in thin gold lamp-rays, two crossed collars and a long under-robe whose wide sleeves hang in dark wet folds; brass toggles, a brass lamp-hook at the sash; a dark grey sealskin mantle over one shoulder against the cold. Hands and objects: a brass storm lamp with horn panes held at shoulder height in his bony right hand; the left hand grips the rough stone parapet. Power: faint blue-white motes of water qi drift about his pale eyes like frost. Background: a deep blue-black sea under stars, mist, a pale slice of broken wall, the faint shape of a far sail. Light: lamplight from the lower right, warm on half the face, cold moonlit blue on the other, a soft rim along the shoulder. Expression: tense, staring, lonely and doubting himself.

people.imagined: Early morning in the stores. She is running her salt-cracked fingers along a column of numbers on an abacus, flicking beads, a cup of tea at her elbow. She has just reached the same total again: one year's oil would build a furlong of wall.
people.subject: The moment: in an early-morning storeroom she flicks the beads of a wooden abacus with quick fingers, her eyes up on the viewer with a brisk, level look. Face: a brisk, narrow face with high cheekbones, a sallow tan; sharp dark alert eyes; thin neat eyebrows; a thin straight nose; a small tidy mouth with a faint amused crease at one corner; fine lines at the eyes. Her hands, cracked and white at the knuckles from salt, fill the lower frame. Hair: black, brushed smooth, twisted into a tight bun with a brass hairpin. Body: slim, quick, straight-backed. Clothing: a steward's neat knee-length robe of oiled grey silk with gold tide embroidery on the collar, over a pale grey gauze under-robe with a white crossed collar and wide sleeves turned back at the cuffs; brass toggles, a brass lamp-hook at the sash and a small jade pendant; a tiny abacus charm hangs from a cord. Hands and objects: a small wooden abacus with dark beads in the left hand, counted with the salt-cracked fingers of the right; a clay cup of tea steams at the edge of the frame. Background: blurred shelves of salt sacks, bundles of dried laver and jars, in soft mist. Light: pale silver morning light from a window at the upper left, with a glowing rim along her cheek. Expression: brisk, shrewd, dry humour.

people.imagined: Dawn at the burned piers. She has just surfaced, hair streaming wet, breathing hard, clutching something in her fist. The pierced lobes of her ears are empty and swollen. She looks over her shoulder, wondering who saw.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she has just broken the surface among black burned pier posts, head and shoulders out of grey water, one fist raised and closed round something small, glancing back over one shoulder. Face: both ear-lobes are pierced through with large holes, empty and stretched, clearly visible against the wet hair. A lean, sea-browned face with wide cheekbones; large dark eyes with a restless gleam, lashes wet; a straight nose; a full mouth half open, panting; drops of water running down her cheeks. Hair: black, streaming and plastered to her head and neck. Body: strong shoulders, bare wet arms, wiry. Clothing: a dark grey diver's wrap of fine tight silk at the shoulders, and a loose open robe of oiled grey gauze floating around her on the water like a drifting cloud, its collar edged in gold wave embroidery; a brass lamp-hook caught in the sash. Hands and objects: the right fist closed on something that glints white between the fingers, a pearl; the left hand grips a charred black pier post. Power: a few drops of water hang in the air around her, glowing faintly blue, and the ripples round her shoulders shimmer. Background: black stumps of burned piers in drifting mist, a pale dawn sea, a dim tower with one small lamp. Light: cold pearl-grey dawn light from the upper left, a thin yellow glow from the far lamp, a soft rim on the wet hair. Expression: breathless, alert and guilty, a quick triumph.

people.imagined: Morning in the southern tower among the reed beds. He squints with one eye shut against a sun that is not there. He is trimming a wick with a reed knife. A rope ladder hangs ready to be hauled up.
people.subject: The moment: in a low tower at morning he trims a lamp wick with a small reed knife, one eye tightly shut and the other open, looking at the viewer. Face: his left eye is held tightly shut in a permanent squint, a fan of deep creases around it, the other eye open and unnaturally steady. A long, narrow, hollow face, tanned to the colour of dry reed; a thin straight nose; thin pale lips set calmly; sparse brown stubble. Hair: dark brown, tied in a topknot with a strip of reed fibre and a plain bone pin. Body: very lean, forearms thin as reeds, shoulders narrow. Clothing: the inner disciple's robe of oiled grey silk with tide embroidery in thin gold at the collar, two crossed collars over a pale reed-green gauze under-robe, wide sleeves rolled back at the forearms; brass toggles, a brass lamp-hook and a jade bead at the sash. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small curved reed knife; in the left a pale wick of twisted reed pith with a freshly cut tip. Power: thin threads of green-and-blue qi coil lazily around the lamp as he works, the faintest hint of a ward-light on the wick. Background: the blurred inside of a round lamp room, brass reflectors, a window onto tall misted reed beds, a coil of rope. Light: soft silver morning light from the upper left, a gleam on the brass and a gentle rim along the jaw. Expression: one eye shut, one eye open, a patient, flat face without warmth as he trims the wick.

people.imagined: Late afternoon in the founder's tower, where he hangs his plans where the head must see them. He is drawing with a stub of chalk on the edge of his cuff, not noticing. He draws on everything.
people.subject: The moment: in the late afternoon he draws with a chalk stub on the white cuff of his own sleeve, tongue tip showing, absorbed, not looking at the viewer. Face: a mild, round-cheeked scholar's face, pale brown, ink-smudged on the left cheek; round dark eyes cast down at his work, brows lifted; a rounded nose with a smudge of chalk dust; a pursed mouth, the tongue tip between the teeth; a thin moustache. Hair: black, brushed back and pinned in a small knot with a bone pin, one chalk-white streak above the ear. Body: round-shouldered, soft. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of oiled grey silk, chalk-dusted down the front, with gold tide embroidery at the collar, two crossed collars and a pale gauze under-robe whose wide left cuff is covered with tiny chalk diagrams of waves and walls; brass toggles, a brass lamp-hook and a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: a thin white chalk stub held like a brush in the right hand; the left forearm raised with the drawn cuff; a roll of plans tucked under the left arm. Power: faint blue-brown motes of earth and water qi trail from the chalk tip, hanging in the air like drifting lines. Background: a blurred pale stone tower wall hung with large sheets of drawn plans, in soft mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light slanting from the upper left, with a gentle glowing rim. Expression: absorbed, gentle, stubborn.

people.imagined: Dusk at the tide lamp in Nhật Xuất. She is tending the lamp with her left hand, black to the wrist with soot. She wipes her eye with the back of the other, solemn and devout, swearing in the name of her dead ancestor.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk she kneels beside a great lamp, her left hand held up black with soot to the wrist like a glove, wiping her eye with the other. Face: her entire left hand and wrist are matte black with lamp soot, in sharp contrast to the rest of her. A solemn, symmetric, oval face, pale brown; level dark eyes, damp at the corners; high straight brows; a straight nose with a smudge of soot at its side; a mouth set in a devout line. Hair: black, in a tight coil at the nape with a plain dark bone pin. Body: slight, upright, kneeling. Clothing: the inner disciple's robe of oiled grey silk, clean at the front and sooty at the cuffs, a collar embroidered in gold with tides and lamp-rays, two crossed collars over a pale grey gauze under-robe with wide sleeves; brass toggles, a brass lamp-hook and a small jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: the left hand black with soot, held open before her; the right hand wipes her eye; a big lit brass tide lamp glows behind her. Power: blue water-qi motes drift up with the lamp's sparks, pale in the heat. Background: a dark round lamp room, the glow of a big flame in a brass bowl, blurred in mist. Light: warm gold lamplight from the upper right and below, cool blue dusk spirit-light on the other cheek. Expression: solemn, devout, tearful, closed.

people.imagined: Early evening at a cove, oars shipped, boat tied. He is laughing at his own joke so loudly it echoes. His nose, broken flat by an oar, spreads wide as he laughs. At night he has drawn nine hulls on the stair wall.
people.subject: The moment: at a cove in the evening he throws his head back and laughs loudly with his mouth wide, one hand slapping the oar on his shoulder. Face: his nose is flattened and spread wide across his face like a boxer's, a crooked broken bridge visible from the front. A broad, sunburnt, boyish face, cheeks round and red; small bright dark eyes squeezed shut with laughter; a mouth gaping open, strong crooked teeth; a few wisps of beard. Hair: black, damp and tousled, tied up with a bit of twine. Body: stocky, broad-chested, strong. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of grey silk, the sleeves hitched high, brass toggles open at the chest over a pale grey under-robe with one crossed collar, damp at the cuffs; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: a long wooden oar with a worn blade rests on his shoulder, held by the right hand; the left slaps his knee; two fingers of the right hand are wrapped in cloth against old cold-bite; a coil of rope over the oar. Background: a rocky cove in drifting mist, a small dark-hulled oil-boat beached half in the frame, the grey rocks glistening. Light: warm gold dusk light from the upper left, a soft glow along his damp shoulder. Expression: uproarious, open, honest.

people.imagined: A grey day at the salt pans, ledger-clerk at a counter. She counts a sum with four fingers of her left hand. She shows the sum openly in the margin for anyone. She has never needed a fifth finger.
people.subject: The moment: at a counting table in a salt-pan shed she holds up four fingers of her left hand, thumb folded, counting a sum aloud and openly, with a frank, direct look at the viewer. Face: a plain, honest, round face, wind-pinked and salt-dried across the nose, with wide-set grey eyes, steady and clear, straight brows, a short straight nose, a broad generous mouth in a slight smile, and a few freckles. Hair: dark brown, braided in two thick plaits pinned up on her head with small brass pins. Body: sturdy and solid, sitting square to the table. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of clean grey silk with brass toggles, a pale grey gauze under-robe with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow, a faint salt crust at the cuffs; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with four fingers raised and the thumb tucked into the palm; the right rests on a thick stack of bound paper sheets tied with string; beside her a small heap of white salt crystals in a wooden dish, glittering. Background: a blurred shed with grey salt pans seen through an open door, pale mist over them. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left, a faint sparkle on the salt and a gentle rim along her cheek. Expression: frank and steady, quietly good-humoured, the calm face of a clerk who has never needed a fifth finger.

people.imagined: Dawn on the shore. She coughs up a little seawater into her fist, though she has not dived in a week. Wet hair at the temples. A pearl-fisher's girl who has been told not to dive and dives anyway in the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on the shore she bends slightly, one fist to her mouth in a cough, a trickle of water at the lip, eyes lifted guiltily to the viewer; a pearl-fisher's girl told not to dive who dived anyway in the dark. Face: a thin, quick, bright face with a scrap of seaweed in the damp hair, large water-bright dark eyes shining with defiance, narrow arched brows, a small nose, a wet full mouth, pale skin with a flush at the cheeks and damp curls at the temples. Hair: black, tangled and still damp, twisted in a rough knot. Body: slight and wiry, hunched with the cough, gooseflesh on her bare forearms. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of grey silk, damp at the cuffs and collar and clinging in dark stains across her narrow shoulders, brass toggles over a pale grey under-robe; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: the right fist at her lips; the left holds a small blue-green stone pendant on a wet cord at her chest, glowing faintly. Power: a faint blue shimmer of water qi lies on her wet hair and a few droplets hang in the air round her. Background: a pale grey dawn shore, wet sand, dark water in mist, a distant tower lamp, a line of black burned pier posts running out into the water, a rope hung between two and a gull on the farthest. Light: cold pearl dawn light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim on the wet hair. Expression: guilty yet defiant, brave, chin lifted over the cough.

people.imagined: A quiet evening at the southern lamp. He sits among bundles of reeds, patient, hands scarred, speaking softly to the reeds he is cutting. He says the oil would be better spent on walls, and says it only to them.
people.subject: The moment: seated in the evening among tied bundles of pale reeds, he cuts a reed with a small knife and murmurs to it, eyes down, gentle. Face: a quiet, long, still face; light brown skin; heavy-lidded brown eyes cast down; faint brow lines; a straight nose; a small smile at one corner of the mouth; sparse young beard. His brows are thin and pale as dry reed and his lashes long and lowered, so his gaze is half hidden. Hair: light brown, tied back in a thin tail with a reed and a wooden pin. Body: lean, relaxed, shoulders sloping; he sits cross-legged on a straw mat, bowed over his work. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of grey silk worn open, brass toggles, over a green-grey gauze under-robe with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: both hands full of pale reeds, every finger marked with fine white healed cuts, a small reed knife in the right hand; pith shavings fall in his lap. Power: tiny green motes of wood qi drift up from the cut reeds like pollen. Background: blurred reed bundles, a dim lamp, a window with sunset mist. Light: warm amber spirit-light from the upper left; a last bar of low sun makes the pale reed bundles glow like straw-gold bars around him. Expression: gentle, content, withdrawn.

people.imagined: Night, at the tide lamp. She has stood the night on the tower top without a lamp and looks at the viewer a breath too long. Her hands are cracked and raw from the ice. She no longer apologises for her stare.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a lamp she looks directly at the viewer, unblinking, a breath too long, her hands held before her raw and cracked. Face: a pale thin face with dark circles under the eyes; wide unblinking dark eyes with a steady stare; thin brows lifted slightly; a straight nose reddened by cold; chapped lips pressed together; a hollow in each cheek. A faint scatter of frost-bitten red marks lies across the bridge of her nose, and there is a small cut on her lower lip. Hair: black, in a single plain braid over the shoulder, frost on the strands. Body: small and thin, straight-backed. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of grey silk, small on her, brass toggles done up to the throat, a soft grey scarf of gauze; the sleeves too long and rolled twice at the wrists so the cuffs look swollen; one toggle missing, replaced by a knot of cord; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: both hands at chest height, palms in, the skin split and red with chilblains, the knuckles swollen; a lit brass lamp on the stone beside her. Power: a pale breath of frost-blue qi hangs round her hands, and a few cold motes drift in the lamplight. Background: a dark blue night, tower stones, a few stars, blurred in mist. Light: warm yellow lamplight on the lower right of her face, cold moonlight from above, a thin silver rim. Expression: fixed, unblinking and steady, grief closed in.

people.imagined: An afternoon on the fort wall. He grins and shows the smudged pirate mark he inked on his own forearm in lamp soot. He holds a nail in his other hand. Gulls scream behind him. He looks like a boy who wants a pirate to exist.
people.subject: The moment: on a fort wall in the afternoon he holds up his forearm to show a smudged soot tattoo while grinning slowly, a large iron nail in the other hand. Face: a grin held too long and a little too wide, the eyes not joining in. A lean, sunburnt, handsome face with high cheeks; narrow, bright, pale brown eyes with no warmth; thick dark brows; a straight nose; a wide mouth with a slow lopsided smile that stays after it should have gone. Hair: black, spiky and sticking up, a red rag tied round the brow like a pirate, a plain pin through the top. Body: wiry, forward-leaning, long arms. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of grey silk, worn open at the chest, brass toggles, over a pale grey under-robe with one crossed collar and the left sleeve pushed up; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: on the left forearm a smudged black soot tattoo of a skull with crossed oars, fingerprint-smeared; the right hand rolls a long iron nail between finger and thumb. Power: a thin grey haze of earth qi gathers about the nail, faint and a little unsteady. Background: a blurred crumbling fort wall in sea mist, a few dark gulls against a pale sky. Light: bright silver afternoon light from the upper left, deep shadows and a crisp rim along the cheek. Expression: a long unblinking grin, cold and eager.

people.imagined: A morning at the burned piers. She stands with a lamp, her hair salt-white and drying even as she watches Trạm Châu Nhi dive. She is soft-hearted and trusting; the oath was for an aunt the sea took.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a burned pier at morning she looks down at the water with a kind, anxious face, one hand held out as if to help someone below. Face: her hair is dry salt-white, a crusted pale grey-white all the way from the root, standing out against her brown skin. A soft, round, young face with big warm brown eyes, brows tilted in worry; a small nose; a gentle mouth; a few freckles. Fine laughter lines already show at the corners of her eyes though she is young, and a small gold stud shines in the left ear. Hair: salt-white, in a long plain tail down her back tied with a grey silk ribbon, strands stiff with dried salt. Body: slim, soft-shouldered, leaning forward. Clothing: the plainest graceful outer-disciple robe of clean grey silk, brass toggles, a pale grey gauze scarf with a salt-bleached edge wound twice round her neck, a crossed collar and sleeves with stiff pale salt at the hem; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: the right hand extended down toward the water, palm open; the left holds a small unlit brass lamp. Power: a faint pearly mist of water qi rises off the pier beside her. Background: black burned piers in drifting mist, grey-green water, a pale morning sky. Light: soft pearl light from the upper left that picks out the white of her hair like frost, a faint sheen on the wet pier. Expression: kind, worried, trusting.

people.imagined: In the fort kitchen by lamplight. He lights the lamp with a taper and turns his face away, aware of the viewer. A wisp of beard sits over the scar on his lip. He is lying to the keeper about the oil.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim fort kitchen he lights a lamp wick with a taper and turns his face half away, a sidelong look at the viewer; he is lying to the keeper about the oil. Face: a pale harelip scar splits his upper lip up to the left nostril, ridged and pink, half hidden by a thin wisp of beard that does not cover it. A long, narrow, sallow face with small shifty light-brown eyes in a sideways glance, a thin nose pulled slightly aside by the scar so the left nostril sits higher, and stubble; his eyes slide away whenever someone looks straight at him. Hair: dark brown, thin and lank, tucked behind his ears and held by a plain pin. Body: thin and slouched, shoulders drawn in. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of oiled grey silk, its seam neatly mended, gold lamp-ray thread at the collar, two crossed collars over a plain pale grey under-robe; a brass lamp-hook at the sash and a pale cloth tied at the waist. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a lit taper to a brass lamp; the left shields the flame; a small oil flask stands on the table. Power: a faint orange-red warmth of fire qi shows round the taper and flickers in his eyes. Background: a dim stone kitchen in smoke and mist, a hanging pot, a blurred barrel, dried fish and garlic on the beams, a little spilled oil shining on the table. Light: warm lamplight from below right, shadow across the other half of the face, a thin silver rim. Expression: secretive and wary, the tight face of a man rehearsing an answer.

people.imagined: A bright morning, plans in hand. She signs her name alone beneath the breakwater drawing. The seams of her nails are stained laver green. She speaks to the head without fear.
people.subject: The moment: in morning light she holds up a rolled sheet of drawn plans and looks straight at the viewer, chin raised, with confident, practised poise. Face: a firm, angular, handsome face, tanned; sharp, dark, direct eyes; strongly arched brows; a straight nose; a well-shaped mouth with a small tilted smile; a clear, ambitious jaw. A small mole sits at the right corner of her mouth, and her gaze is held a moment longer than is comfortable. Hair: black, in a high smooth tail bound with a green silk cord and a small jade wave pin. Body: tall, straight, shoulders back; she holds the plan roll like a baton, elbow out. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of fine grey silk with gold tide embroidery on the standing collar, two crossed collars over a pale grey gauze under-robe, wide sleeves narrowing to neat cuffs; brass toggles, a small brass wave pin at the collar, a brass lamp-hook and a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a rolled plan sheet drawn with waves and walls; the nails of both hands carry fine laver-green stains at the seams. Power: a faint ring of brown-gold earth qi turns slowly about the roll, with a few yellow motes. Background: a blurred pale stone wall with a sunlit window and the misted sea; a second roll of plans leans on a table, and a small stone breakwater model sits on the sill. Light: crisp silver-gold morning light from the upper left, a glowing rim on her hair. Expression: confident, composed, calculating.

people.imagined: A hot afternoon by the oil cauldron. He sits slumped on a stool, half asleep through the second boil, gulls wheeling round his head. He smells of fish oil in every season.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a stool by a giant cauldron in the afternoon steam, he dozes with his head tipped, one eye cracked open, gulls clustered near his shoulder. Face: a broad, round, greasy face, shiny with oil, brown skin loose at the jowls; small sleepy eyes with heavy lids, one open to a slit; a big shapeless nose; a loose wet mouth, drooping; grey stubble; a content slackness. A gleam of fish oil shines on his forehead and nose and a film of grease on the jowls. Hair: thin grey, plastered to the scalp, shiny with oil. Body: heavy, soft, slumped, belly round. Clothing: a servant's plain but clean grey silk-cotton coat, unbuttoned and straining, a pale grey inner shirt with the sleeves rolled and grease-dark on the forearms; the pockets sag, one holding a lump of dried salt fish, and the toggles are done up in the wrong holes so the front hangs crooked; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: a long wooden paddle in his slack right hand, its end resting in the cauldron of golden oil; the left hand hangs over his knee; three grey and white gulls perch on the cauldron rim and the stool. Background: a hazy shed with a huge iron cauldron and drifting steam, rows of oil casks with wet rims, a heap of fish heads. Light: warm hazy gold light from the upper left through steam, a soft glow on the oil. Expression: drooping lids, a slack comfortable mouth and a head tipped to one shoulder, drowsy and quite content.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at twenty-two, the night Châu Lệ Cảng burned: a pearl diver on a black pier with the harbour burning orange behind her, standing straight, not weeping, taking its name for her own.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened, of a young pearl diver standing straight on a black pier with a burning harbour behind her. Face: a hard, set young face lit orange on one side; a lean, brown, high-cheeked face; wide dark eyes that do not blink, reflecting small flames; straight dark brows; a short straight nose; a mouth pressed shut and pale, jaw tight; a streak of soot across the cheek. Fine droplets of water cling to her eyelashes, and a small scar from a coral cut shows white at the left temple. Hair: black, wet and long, hanging over one shoulder in a thick rope with a strip of blue diver's line wound round it. Body: strong, slim, shoulders squared, upright. Clothing: a dark blue diver's tunic of tight silk with seams stitched in tarred line, a layered grey sea-cloak of gauze drifting from one shoulder like smoke, bare strong arms; as yet no sect's robe, the first dress of the house that would be. Hands and objects: both hands hang at her sides, the right holding a single large grey pearl between finger and thumb, plain and visible. Power: a faint blue-white glimmer of water qi gathers round the pearl, the first spark of her way. Background: a wash of orange and black smoke, the outline of burning piers and masts, faded; over the masts a flock of dark birds wheels upward and the water at the pier's foot reflects the orange glow. Light: faint, even, as on old silk, with an orange glow on the left cheek. Expression: stony, grieving, resolved.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the sworn brother at the Kim Sa lamp on the festival night of 913, as the storm tide rises: he keeps the lamp burning with his own coat held over it, laughing in the wind, trusting his friend will return.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, edges darkened, of a man shielding a lamp from rain and spray with the flap of his coat, smiling into the wind. Face: a broad, friendly, weathered brown face with deep laugh lines; bright dark eyes crinkled with a trusting warmth; thick black brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth in an open smile with strong teeth; a short black beard flecked with spray. Hair: black, wet with sea spray, a dark blue cloth knotted round the head, a strand of dark sea-wrack tangled in it, drops of spray gleaming in his beard. Body: big, broad-shouldered, braced against the wind. Clothing: a dark blue pearl-diver's robe of silk with seams stitched in tarred line and a collar embroidered in thin gold tides, over it a long coat of oiled grey silk thrown over the shoulder and held up like a shield, wide wet sleeves streaming; a brass lamp-hook at the sash. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small bronze lamp in a nest of coat cloth, the flame low and bright, shielded from the storm. Power: a soft pale-blue halo of water qi gathers round the little flame, ghostly with age. Background: a wash of dark grey and blue, rain slanting, a pale tide rising; at the far edge a line of tall breakers above the dark town's roofs, faded to ghostly white. Light: faint, even as on old silk, a warm glow from the lamp on the chin. Expression: trusting, warm, a laugh against the storm.
